title: Securing suspended scaffolds.
officialText: At the end of the shift, the suspended scaffold shall be cleared of all equipment and material susceptible to dislodgement and shall be lowered to the street or deck of the sidewalk shed, or shall be secured to the roof or building in accordance with design drawings required by Section 3314.3.3.
